reference_sql:
WITH earbuds AS (SELECT p.product_id FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Earbuds'),
promo AS (SELECT pp.product_id FROM promotion_products pp JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = pp.promo_id WHERE pr.promo_code = 'P-2025-05')
SELECT COALESCE(e.product_id, pm.product_id) AS product_id, e.product_id IS NOT NULL AS in_earbuds, pm.product_id IS NOT NULL AS in_promotion
FROM earbuds e
FULL OUTER JOIN promo pm ON pm.product_id = e.product_id

solver.query:
WITH e AS (
  SELECT p.product_id
  FROM products p
  JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  WHERE c.category_name = 'Earbuds'
), pr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pp.product_id
  FROM promotion_products pp
  JOIN promotions x ON x.promo_id = pp.promo_id
  WHERE x.promo_code = 'P-2025-05'
)
SELECT COALESCE(e.product_id, pr.product_id) AS product_id,
       e.product_id IS NOT NULL AS in_earbuds,
       pr.product_id IS NOT NULL AS in_promotion
FROM e
FULL OUTER JOIN pr ON pr.product_id = e.product_id
